newsitem.title: FRANCE: France's Chirac to visit China, drops Hong Kong.
newsitem.headline: France's Chirac to visit China, drops Hong Kong.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac will visit China from May 15 to18 but has dropped a planned stopover in Hong Kong because of France's snap parliamentary election, presidential aides said on Wednesday.
The election is scheduled for May 25 and June 1.
Chirac will visit Beijing and Shanghai, where a French trade exhibition is to open during his visit.
Chinese Prime Minister Li Peng visited France last year and Parliament head Qiao Shi met Chirac in Paris on March 27.
The French leader will be accompanied by his wife Bernadette and several senior ministers.

A string of French ministers have visited China in recent months to prepare Chirac's visit during which the president is expected to make strong overtures in favour of French industries, including arms manufacturers.
